name: issue-board
title: Issue Board
description: A kanban board with status transitions and inline issue creation.
usage: <IssueBoard defaultIssues={[{ id: "UI-7", title: "Search", status: "active", priority: "high", points: 3 }]} />
useCases: At stand-up, a developer moves a card from backlog to active so the team sees the task’s new status.
During intake, a manager creates a task directly on the board. The app saves the updated list and refreshes its other views.
task: A kanban board with status transitions and inline issue creation.
behavior: Use defaultIssues for a local board. To synchronize with the table, give both the same issues array and onIssuesChange handler. Each issue needs a stable ID.
